research.title: Lunar distance
research.note: Supplies the About page fact "A line to the Moon": Orrin is much farther than that, which is why the line is thin and text-only, but nothing in the story waits on a delay.

research.title: Queqiao relay satellite
research.note: Supplies the About page fact "Why a relay": Sparrow is a dark relay, and lighting it is one of three ways home.

inspiration.title: Lifeline
inspiration.note: The shape of a story told as a text conversation with many branching choices; Stranded adds no waiting timer and a free rewind to try a different path.

other.title: Pyodide
other.note: Runs the game's Python rules in the browser through WebAssembly (version 0.26.4, loaded from a CDN), so the game needs no server of its own and no build step.
